rationale: Explicitly states the product supports machine learning workloads alongside its core conventional big data processing and interactive analytics, using open-source frameworks. The core offering (petabyte-scale data processing on Spark/Hive/Presto frameworks) remains without the ML use, so it is AI-enabled rather than AI-native.
ai_type_rationale: Core big data processing and analytics are described independently of ML; machine learning is an added workload the platform supports.
evidence_spans: Amazon EMR is a cloud big data solution for petabyte-scale data processing, interactive analytics, and machine learning using open-source frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Hive, and Presto.
